articles.summary: NASHVILLE and CINCINNATI – The Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports have created a landmark multi-year media rights agreement that brings free, over-the-air access to the Predators’ National Hockey League games to fans across Middle Tennessee and beyond beginning with the 2026–27 NHL season.
articles.title: Scripps Sports, Nashville Predators partner on multi-year agreement to air National Hockey League team’s games

articles.summary: Scripps News, the national streaming network owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, has been recognized with three prestigious National Headliner Awards, including a Best in Show honor, and two Deadline Club finalist nominations. KNXV, Scripps’ ABC station in Phoenix, also received three National Headliner Awards
articles.title: Scripps receives seven National Headliner Awards and earns Deadline Club finalist nominations

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – Scripps Sports has entered into a comprehensive multi-year broadcast partnership with Professional Bull Riders (PBR), the global leader in bull riding entertainment, to bring Premier Women’s Rodeo (PWR) exclusively to Scripps’ national television networks ION and Grit beginning in May.
articles.title: Scripps Sports secures multi-year partnership with Premier Women’s Rodeo

articles.summary: Scripps News, the national network owned by The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP), has tapped veteran journalist Jay Gray to serve as a senior national correspondent, effective Monday, April 13.
articles.title: Veteran journalist Jay Gray joins Scripps News as senior national correspondent

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) will report first-quarter 2026 operating results after the markets close on Thursday, May 7. The call with the company’s senior management team will take place at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, May 8.
articles.title: Scripps to release first-quarter 2026 operating results on May 7
